title: Worships Effect On Personal Perfection Sincerity Warning

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: Worship helps a person grow, become better, and reach the high purpose Allah made him for.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the human being on the outside?
questions.answer: A person is described as physically small, weak, and lacking power.

questions.question: What special things does the passage say a person has inside?
questions.answer: A person has a noble soul, great abilities, many wishes, many thoughts, and broad inner powers.

questions.question: Why does the passage say worship increases a person’s worth?
questions.answer: Because it helps the person’s inner gifts grow and makes him fit for lasting happiness.

questions.question: What does worship do for a person’s desires and tendencies?
questions.answer: It corrects them and cleans them.

questions.question: How does worship help with a person’s hopes and ideas?
questions.answer: It helps hopes become meaningful and useful, and it puts thoughts in order.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship does to a person’s strong inner powers?
questions.answer: It controls them and keeps them within proper limits.

questions.question: What picture is used to explain what worship removes from a person?
questions.answer: It is compared to taking away rust so the person becomes clear like a window.

questions.question: When does worship raise a person fully, according to the passage?
questions.answer: When it is done with conscience, mind, heart, and body together.

questions.question: What kind of relationship is worship between the servant and Allah?
questions.answer: It is a noble and elevated connection.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the highest level of human perfection?
questions.answer: It is the special servant-to-Allah relationship made through worship.

questions.question: What is sincerity in worship?
questions.answer: It means worshipping only because Allah commanded it.

questions.question: How should benefits of worship be treated if someone knows about them?
questions.answer: They may encourage the person, but they should not be the main reason for worship.

questions.question: What happens if a person makes the benefits the real reason for worship?
questions.answer: Then the worship is spoiled.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the human being surprising or unusual?
questions.answer: Because even though a person’s body is weak and small, he carries great inner abilities and countless hopes and thoughts.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship does for the human spirit?
questions.answer: It makes the spirit grow and become elevated.

questions.question: How does worship help a person’s hidden talents?
questions.answer: It brings them out and helps them develop.

questions.question: What future gift does worship help a person become ready for?
questions.answer: It helps a person become worthy of everlasting happiness.

questions.question: In what way does worship help fix a person’s character?
questions.answer: It purifies and straightens a person’s leanings and inner habits.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about worship and thinking?
questions.answer: Worship gathers a person’s thoughts and arranges them properly.

questions.question: Which three inner powers are mentioned as needing control?
questions.answer: Desire, anger, and intellect.

questions.question: What does worship do for the body and soul, according to the image in the passage?
questions.answer: It clears away what blocks them so they can reflect truth more clearly.

questions.question: Which parts of a person should join in worship?
questions.answer: The conscience, mind, heart, and body should all take part.

questions.question: What does worship help a person reach?
questions.answer: It helps a person reach the honor and completion prepared for him.

questions.question: How is the bond formed by worship described?
questions.answer: It is described as refined, high, and honorable.

questions.question: What is the correct reason for doing worship?
questions.answer: The correct reason is that Allah commanded it.

questions.question: Can wisdoms and benefits be present in worship?
questions.answer: Yes, many wisdoms and benefits can be in it.

questions.question: What is the difference between a benefit encouraging worship and a benefit becoming the main cause?
questions.answer: Encouragement is allowed, but making the benefit the true motive ruins sincerity.

questions.question: What contrast about human beings appears at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: A person is weak in body but rich in spirit and inner potential.

questions.question: What does worship do to these wide inner capacities?
questions.answer: It helps them open up, grow, and move in the right direction.

questions.question: How does worship affect a person’s value?
questions.answer: It raises a person’s rank and worth.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship can do for hopes?
questions.answer: It can help them become productive and meaningful.

questions.question: If someone’s thoughts are scattered, how would worship help according to the passage?
questions.answer: It would organize those thoughts and bring order to them.

questions.question: Why is limiting strong inner powers a good thing in this passage?
questions.answer: Because those powers need control so they do not go beyond proper bounds.

questions.question: What can we infer from the window example?
questions.answer: When a person is spiritually cleaned, he can better reflect and receive what is good and true.

questions.question: Why is it not enough for only the body to worship?
questions.answer: Because true worship should involve the whole person, including the conscience, mind, and heart.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship helps a person become worthy of?
questions.answer: It helps a person become worthy of his true human dignity and lasting happiness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the servant’s connection to Allah through worship?
questions.answer: As a very high, beautiful, and honorable bond.

questions.question: What is the clearest sign of sincerity in worship?
questions.answer: Doing it for Allah’s command alone.

questions.question: Are the benefits of worship unimportant in the passage?
questions.answer: No. They are real and many, but they are not supposed to be the main motive.

questions.question: What mistake makes worship invalid in the passage?
questions.answer: Treating personal benefit as the real reason for the act of worship.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the human body compared with the human inner life?
questions.answer: The body is limited and weak, but the inner life is noble and full of great possibilities.

questions.question: How does worship help a person move toward that greater purpose?
questions.answer: It develops the person’s spirit and abilities so he can grow toward true success.

questions.question: What kind of happiness is worship said to prepare a person for?
questions.answer: It prepares a person for everlasting happiness.

questions.question: Besides building the spirit, what does worship do for personal behavior?
questions.answer: It fixes and purifies a person’s inner tendencies.

questions.question: What does worship do for a person whose mind feels messy or confused?
questions.answer: It helps gather and arrange the person’s thoughts.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying worship restrains inner powers?
questions.answer: It means worship keeps desire, anger, and thinking from going too far.

questions.question: Why is rust a good image in this passage?
questions.answer: Because rust covers and weakens things, and worship removes what blocks a person’s natural clarity.

questions.question: What happens when a person worships with every part of himself?
questions.answer: He rises to the level of honor and completion meant for him.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes worship such an important act?
questions.answer: It creates a lofty bond between the servant and Allah.

questions.question: What is the highest human perfection mentioned here?
questions.answer: It is this noble bond with Allah through worship.

questions.question: What is meant by sincerity in worship?
questions.answer: It means the worship is done because Allah ordered it, not for some other main goal.

questions.question: If a person notices benefits in worship, how should he respond?
questions.answer: He may let those benefits encourage him, but he should still worship for Allah’s command.

questions.question: What result comes from making benefits the main motive?
questions.answer: The worship loses its soundness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the human being in one short summary?
questions.answer: A person is outwardly weak but inwardly full of amazing gifts.

questions.question: What are some examples of the inner gifts named in the passage?
questions.answer: A high spirit, great potential, many desires, many hopes, many ideas, and broad inner powers.

questions.question: What does worship do for those gifts?
questions.answer: It helps them grow and become useful in the right way.

questions.question: How does worship affect a person’s standing or rank?
questions.answer: It lifts the person’s value.

questions.question: What does the passage say worship does for human inclinations?
questions.answer: It corrects and cleans them.

questions.question: How does worship help hopes become better?
questions.answer: It helps them reach good results instead of staying empty wishes.

questions.question: How does worship help a student-like skill such as thinking clearly?
questions.answer: It puts ideas in order and helps the mind become more organized.

questions.question: What are worshippers protected from when worship limits inner powers?
questions.answer: They are protected from letting desire, anger, or intellect go out of balance.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the image of body parts and spiritual parts becoming like windows?
questions.answer: Worship makes the person clearer and more open to reflecting what is right.

questions.question: What must be included for worship to raise a person fully?
questions.answer: The whole person must take part, not just one part.

questions.question: How is the relationship made by worship described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as delicate, exalted, and honorable.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the true basis of sincere worship?
questions.answer: Obeying Allah’s command.

questions.question: Are reasons and benefits completely denied in the passage?
questions.answer: No. They exist, but they should stay secondary.

questions.question: What is allowed, and what is not allowed, regarding benefits in worship?
questions.answer: It is allowed for benefits to encourage worship, but it is not allowed for them to become the main reason.

questions.question: What problem in human life does worship answer in this passage?
questions.answer: It answers the problem of a weak human body joined with very large inner needs and abilities.

questions.question: Why might a human being need help to reach his full purpose, based on the passage?
questions.answer: Because he has huge inner potential and many desires, hopes, and thoughts that need guidance and growth.

questions.question: What role does worship play in helping a person reach that purpose?
questions.answer: It grows the spirit, develops abilities, and prepares the person for true success.

questions.question: What kind of success is bigger than worldly success in this passage?
questions.answer: Being fit for eternal happiness.

questions.question: What does worship do for a person’s inner leanings when they are not right?
questions.answer: It reforms and purifies them.

questions.question: What cause-and-effect idea about worship and thoughts appears in the passage?
questions.answer: Worship brings a person’s ideas together and makes them orderly.

questions.question: Why is controlling appetite, anger, and intellect important?
questions.answer: Because they are powerful and need limits so the person stays balanced.

questions.question: What effect does worship have on a person’s physical and spiritual parts?
questions.answer: It removes what dulls them so they can become clear and useful like windows.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about worship done only with outward actions?
questions.answer: It is not the full form, because worship should include the inner and outer parts together.

questions.question: What does full worship raise a person to?
questions.answer: It raises him to the honor and completion meant for him.

questions.question: Why is the connection made by worship so important?
questions.answer: Because it is the highest form of human completion.

questions.question: What does sincerity require even when worship has many benefits?
questions.answer: It requires choosing Allah’s command as the real reason for the worship.

questions.question: What is the proper place of wisdoms and benefits in worship?
questions.answer: They may support and encourage the person, but they stay secondary.

questions.question: What happens if someone worships mainly to get those benefits?
questions.answer: The worship is no longer sincere and is counted as invalid.
